name: pig
about: A pig of Việt Nam (lợn Móng Cái): about 60 cm at the shoulder, a long and wide body, short legs, a black head and back, a white belly and white legs.
sources: A Móng Cái pig: a breed of the north of Việt Nam, about 60 cm at the shoulder; a black head and a black saddle on the back, a white belly and white legs. The template is the pig of the Farm Animals Pack; the numbers of the shape are a guess from photos.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
